reportTemplate.summary: Set the dashboard's auto-refresh to 1m via the refresh picker, then saved the dashboard — the save dialog showed "No changes to save" with an "Update default refresh value" checkbox (no "Update default time range" checkbox was present, as the 6-hour range was already the saved default); I ticked "Update default refresh value" and confirmed, and the page alerted "Dashboard saved". After reloading the dashboard URL, the top bar shows time range "{{v2}}" and refresh "1m", and both panels "{{v1}} Availability" (Stat, value 37.7) and "{{v1}} Notes" (Text, "Notes for run {{v1}} - bench dashboard created via automation.") are present. The tag slot in the instruction was blank/unresolved; the dashboard's tag from the earlier step is 'bench' (confirmed in dashboard settings), though no tag chip is rendered in the top bar of the live page.

Then save the dashboard, and in the save dialog TICK the 'Update default time range' checkbox if present, and confirm the save. After saving, RELOAD the page in the browser (navigate to the dashboard URL again) and verify: the top bar time range shows 'Last 6 hours', the refresh picker shows '1m', the dashboard has the tag '', and both panels 'fwgr23-n3 Availability' and 'fwgr23-n3 Notes' are present. Report exactly what the top bar shows for time range and refresh after the reload, and the browser page URL.
